capabilities: render timestamped story beats as a circular storyclock
log story events with HH:MM:SS timestamps
set the story's total runtime on the first line
toggle between editing source text and viewing the rendered clock
disambiguation: Not a timer or time-tracking tool; it visualizes a story's structure on a clock face from timestamps you type.
extras: The README points to an external video by Seth Worley to explain the Storyclock process.
intentEvidence: It is inspired by the Storyclock notebook by Plot Devices.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to map a story's events onto the circular storyclock structure used to spot gaps and symmetries in timed stories.

relations.evidence: It is inspired by the Storyclock notebook by Plot Devices.

summary: Renders timestamped story beats as a circular storyclock diagram, inspired by the Plot Devices Storyclock notebook.
